question: F6
answer:
Implemented scheme-timeout recovery.

- Timed-out payments are saved as `RECEIVED` and return 201.
- Added scheduled `SchemeRetryJob.resubmit()` every 5 minutes.
- Retries reuse the existing `P{id}` scheme reference.
- Handles duplicate acknowledgements after an accepted timeout.
- Added regression coverage.

Validation: `mvn -o -q test` passes all 35 tests.

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/main/java/com/example/accounts/payment/PaymentService.java; sed -n '1,220p' src/main/java/com/example/accounts/payment/PaymentDispatcher.java; sed -n '1,180p' src/main/java/com/example/accounts/payment/QueuedPaymentJob.java; sed -n '1,180p' src/main/java/com/example/accounts/payment/PaymentRepository.java; sed -n '1,180p' src/main/java/com/example/accounts/payment/Payment.java; sed -n '1,180p' src/test/java/com/example/accounts/PaymentApiTest.java; sed -n '1,140p' src/test/java/com/example/accounts/support/FakeScheme.java; sed -n '1,130p' src/test/java/com/example/accounts/support/ApiTest.java; sed -n '1,120p' src/main/java/com/example/accounts/AccountsApplication.java; sed -n '1,140p' README.md"
